display_name: DURA 多时滞四阶累积量七景测试
description: 大容量 DURA 波形修正网络以当前信号的多时滞有限窗 C22/C31 统计为条件，以源配对 IQ 和同统计损失训练。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU5 deterministic FP32 TF32 off, GPU source training, GPU recovery with frozen CPU Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, CPU truth-last

data.representation: fixed candidate on GPU plus frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL CPU default head on identical fixed Phase1 input
data.physical_ids_ref: 168000 fixed Phase1 Main split ground physical records in each of seven views
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.validation_ref: Seven fixed predictions precede independent truth-last scoring
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: G training uses paired L_s/U_s IQ only with TX hidden; F weights and outputs only in separate source no-query smoke and after G freezes for evaluation.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA plus independently initialized 14966274-parameter attention/local cumulant-conditioned recovery model; final output projection initialized to zero
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed source context cache validated for 32768 legal L_s/U_s source fit IDs and epochs21/22/23; frozen DURA original provenance; no F/TX/V/target in G training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen source-only DURA and matching source cache; new recovery network initialized independently; frozen F only separate source no-query smoke and final evaluation
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch20; no target or source-score checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU5: one this-task worker per GPU stage, >=8192 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner on source role or contract mismatch, nonfinite output, wrong checkpoint, target or F/TX leakage, output collision, failed source no-query smoke, or systemic technical failure; preserve other owners and artifacts.

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU subprocess ground score after seven complete predictions

rows.method: Full-window 8-layer width384 attention with local path and bounded centered lagged C22/C31 statistics from received, anchor and innovation; source IQ + .02 DURA change + .1 matched-cumulant loss
rows.purpose: Freeze source model and score the fixed Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head
rows.seed_notes: Model seed 2026110901; source fit 2026110611; training order 2026110902; evaluation 2026092701.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views
rows.budget_ref: 168000 fixed Phase1 Main split ground IDs x seven views, same frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL reader; independent truth-last

notes: Finite-window normalized cumulant estimates are not claimed invariant to receiver or channel, nor proven to encode transmitter identity.
Source paired IQ only, TX labels hidden and no F outputs or weights, V, target IQ or target truth in G training.
Fixed final epoch20; no-query real-checkpoint smoke, then complete seven-view predictions before independent truth-last; historical ground test exposed, not blind or real satellite.
